context: A geography teacher and student review a nature documentary
purpose: Teach: 大陸/国土/海岸/天然/食料/衛星/輸送/循環

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、昨日見たドキュメンタリー、アジア大陸の自然がすごく印象的でした。
lines.en: Teacher, the documentary I watched yesterday, the nature of the Asian continent was really impressive.
lines.style: Enthusiastic university student sharing genuine excitement after viewing

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ああ、あの番組ね。広い国土を持つ国の地理的な特徴がよく分かったでしょう?
lines.en: Ah, that program. You could clearly see the geographical features of countries with vast national land, right?
lines.style: Warm teacher voice guiding student toward deeper understanding

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、特に長い海岸線と天然資源の豊かさには驚きました。
lines.en: Yes, I was especially surprised by the long coastline and the abundance of natural resources.
lines.style: Thoughtful student reflecting on specific documentary details

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうね。沿岸地域は漁業も盛んで、食料品の供給にも大きく貢献しているの。
lines.en: Right. Coastal regions also have thriving fisheries, contributing greatly to food supply.
lines.style: Patient educator connecting concepts to real-world impact

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 気象衛星の映像も使われていて、すごく分かりやすかったです。
lines.en: Meteorological satellite footage was also used, which made it very easy to understand.
lines.style: Engaged learner appreciating educational presentation techniques

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あの輸送機関の発達と物流の話は、経済地理にもつながる重要な話題よ。
lines.en: That topic about the development of transportation systems and logistics connects to economic geography.
lines.style: Knowledgeable teacher expanding scope toward broader academic themes

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 資源循環の仕組みについても、もっと詳しく勉強したいと思いました。
lines.en: I also want to study the mechanism of resource circulation in more detail.
lines.style: Motivated student expressing curiosity about further learning

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい姿勢ね。来週の授業で関連資料を一緒に見てみましょう。
lines.en: That's a good attitude. Let's look at related materials together in next week's class.
lines.style: Encouraging mentor offering supportive follow-up plan
